tabs.title: Subclasses
displayed_texts: subclasses
A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
The _Berserker_ builds rage as he takes damage. Rage increases his damage and can be activated at 100% for bonus shielding.
The _Gladiator_ builds combo when he makes successful attacks. He can spend combo to use unique abilities.

details.title:
The Berserker gains rage as he takes physical damage, including damage that gets blocked by his armor! Rage steadily fades away over time, but fades more slowly if he is at low HP.

Rage can cause the Berserker to deal up to +50% damage. At max rage he can go berserk, gaining a burst of shielding and keeping his rage as long as he has shielding left. The shielding scales with the level of the berserker's armor, and can be massively boosted if he is at low health. The Berserker needs time to recover after he goes berserk.

The Gladiator builds one point of combo every time he makes a successful attack with a melee or thrown weapon. If the Gladiator does not make a successful attack within 5 turns (15 turns after a kill), his combo is reset.

As he builds combo the Gladiator can use a variety of abilities that are guaranteed to hit:
2 Combo: knock enemy back, preserves combo
4 Combo: deal damage based on armor
6 Combo: parry, preserves combo
8 Combo: damage target and nearby enemies
10 Combo: attack once for each combo

details.title:
The Warrior leaps toward a targeted location, going over any enemies or hazards in the way. He cannot leap over walls or other solid terrain however.

Charge cost: _35_

The Warrior slams the ground, producing a shockwave that travels up to 5 tiles in a 60 degree cone.

Enemies caught in this shockwave are crippled for 5 turns. They also take 5-10 damage, plus an additional 1-2 damage for every point of strength the Warrior has above 10.

Charge cost: _35_

The Warrior endures for 3 turns, taking half damage from all sources. This reduction is applied before damage resisting effects like armor.

After enduring, the warrior's next hit within 10 turns gains bonus damage. This bonus damage is equal to half of all the damage inflicted on him while enduring, before any damage reduction effects!

If the Warrior has any combo, using this ability increases its remaining time by 3 turns.

Charge cost: _50_

Charge cost: _25_

The Mage places a beacon, which can then be warped to at will. Placing the beacon takes 1 turn, but warping to it is instantaneous.

The Mage cannot warp between floors by default, or use the beacon to reach inaccessible places such as locked rooms. The Mage can teleport into enemies, which will push them aside.

details.title:
The Sniper is a master of ranged combat, whose ranged attacks pierce enemy armor. When she attacks an enemy with a thrown weapon, she places a sniper's mark on them, which lets her follow up with a special attack from her bow. This special attack varies based on how her bow is augmented.

An unaugmented bow will fire a snapshot which deals reduced damage but fires instantly. A speed bow will fire a volley of three arrows which deal reduced damage, can still activate enchantments, and take 1 turn to fire. A damage bow will fire a sniper shot which is guaranteed to hit, deals bonus damage based on distance, and takes 2 turns to fire.

The Warden has a strong connection to nature which grants her a variety of bonus effects relating to grass and plants. She is able to see through tall and furrowed grass as if it were empty space.

The Warden causes grass to sprout up around any seed she throws or plants, and gains special effects when trampling plants. These special effects replace the regular plant effects, meaning that no plant is harmful for her to step on.

details.title:
The Berserker gains rage as he takes physical damage, including damage that gets blocked by his armor! Rage steadily fades away over time, but fades more slowly if he is at low HP.

Rage can cause the Berserker to deal up to +50% damage. At max rage he can go berserk, gaining a burst of shielding and keeping his rage as long as he has shielding left. The Gladiator builds one point of combo every time he makes a successful attack with a melee or thrown weapon. If the Gladiator does not make a successful attack within 5 turns (15 turns after a kill), his combo is reset.

As he builds combo the Gladiator can use a variety of abilities that are guaranteed to hit:
2 Combo: knock enemy back, preserves combo
4 Combo: deal damage based on armor
6 Combo: parry, preserves combo
8 Combo: damage target and nearby enemies
